findings.claim: The page taught as universal that a paged collection fetch join pages in memory; Hibernate 7.4.13, managed by Spring Boot 4.1.2, pages in a subquery where the database supports limits and offsets in subqueries.

evidence.section: fixing-n-1-with-join-fetch: Limits and offsets: fixed for many-valued fetch joins on databases that support limits and offsets in subqueries; in-memory limit otherwise, notably Sybase ASE

findings.recommendation: State the database-capability-dependent Hibernate 7.4 behavior and label any portable recommendation as such.
